newsitem.title: USA: USDA amends PL480 pact with El Salvador.
newsitem.headline: USDA amends PL480 pact with El Salvador.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday it had amended a PL-480 agreement with El Salvador to allow larger purchases of tallow and soybean meal.
The authorization for tallow purchases was increased to $6.4 million. It had been $3.6 million.
Authorization for purchase of vegetable oil was increased to $6.1 million. It had been $3.6 million.
USDA said under the new authorizations, up to 14,000 tonnes of tallow and 22,000 tonnes of soymeal could be sold. The previous figures were 8,500 tonnes of tallow and 13,000 tonnes of soymeal.
